options.label: Write a PRD for this project
options.description: Define the problem, target user, core features with acceptance criteria, what is explicitly out of scope, and any technical constraints. Produce the spec artifact itself — the document, with the five named sections.

options.label: Define the problem and success criteria first
options.description: Who is this for, what problem does it solve, and how will we know when it's done? Lock the problem statement and how to recognise done before expanding into architecture.

options.label: List the top 3 unknowns blocking a clear spec
options.description: Name the three things you'd need to know or decide before a PRD could be written. Forces the key open questions into the open before architecture decisions get made ad-hoc.
